mentions.name: Self-Employed Bookkeeping & Tax Tracker
mentions.description: This app is a self-employed bookkeeping and tax-prep tool built as a replacement for QuickBooks Self Employed. It integrates Plaid to pull in transactions, lets users categorize business spending using official IRS categories, and tracks business income. It provides graphs of business spending, income, and profit by month, quarter, and year, and exports data to CSV for easy entry into Schedule C at tax time. A planned future feature is estimating quarterly taxes, showing approximately how much should be paid each quarter along with due dates.
mentions.problem: QuickBooks Self Employed is awful, leaving self-employed people without a good tool for categorizing business finances and preparing taxes.
mentions.audience: Self-employed individuals managing their business finances and taxes
mentions.source_excerpt:
Replacement for Quickbooks Self Employed (which is awful). Integrates Plaid and allows you to categorize business spending by official IRS categories and business income. Graphs of business spending, income, profit by month, quarter, and year. Export to CSV for easy entry into schedule C at tax time.

Future feature is estimating quarterly taxes and showing approximately how much should be paid each quarter if any and due dates.
mentions.author: nodesocket
